title: Queued-prompt durability persisted fixtures should await their root cleanup receipt
outcome: Each converted real persisted-state queued-prompt durability test attributes root cleanup success or failure before it finishes, using existing cleanup receipts and synchronization.
acceptance: The three real persisted-state tests in queued_prompt_durability register the existing TestTempRoot cleanup observer and await its result after dropping or joining their state owners, using existing phase_sync/cleanup helpers without sleeps, retries, longer timeouts or product changes.
Focused tests cover the three converted fixtures and their retained-root regression; a cleanup failure cannot be silently printed after the test reports success.
